title: Keep it to one short task

do.text: Use a dialog for one short task: a rename, a confirmation, a two-field edit.

dont.text: Don't put a long form in a dialog: give it a page or a [Sheet](/components/sheet).

do.text: Name the action in the title and on the button ("Delete project").

dont.text: Don't ask "Are you sure?" with an "OK" button: neither says what happens.
